subject: PAGE clause
notes: kb/Work PB1059: reportPageClause is the rendered diagram (PDF p468): `PAGE [LIMIT IS|LIMITS ARE] { integer-1 | [integer-1 {LINE|LINES}] [integer-2 {COLS|COLUMNS}] }` as three alternatives, then the five phrases HEADING / FIRST {DETAIL|DE} / LAST {CONTROL HEADING|CH} / LAST {DETAIL|DE} / FOOTING, each at most once (COBOL2423) in any order. Not edition-gated: no gate is derivable from the spec (row 130d). Re-affirmed 2026-10-22 (kb/Work PB3530) against the figure regenerated from the printed page: render_figure.py's brace-group layout now keeps every alternative inside its own enclosure, so the diagram's layout changed while its words did not (sweep_figures.py's word gate); the verdict stands on the printed format. || kb/Work PB3751 (2026-10-25): the bracket [ LIMIT IS | LIMITS ARE ] is all optional words on the printed page (only PAGE is ruled, PDF p468), and reportPageClause demanded LIMIT before IS and LIMITS before ARE, so `PAGE IS 60` was a COBOL0001 while this row read CONFORMS. Now `(LIMIT IS? | IS | LIMITS ARE? | ARE)?`: every spelling of either alternative, never a word of each (cite.py --check 8.3.2.4.3 "may be specified at the user's option with no effect on the semantics of the format" OK; 5.2.6.2 "one of the alternatives contained within the brackets may be explicitly specified" OK).
